verdict.rationale: Datalab's Pipelines feature is explicitly described as creating 'versioned, reusable configurations' for chaining processors, and agent processors can be pinned to a specific version (id@version), showing some versioning capability. However, there is no evidence of a review workflow (diffing/approving changes) or an explicit rollback mechanism to revert a pipeline to a prior version. Missing for 10: review/audit UI for pipeline changes, explicit rollback/revert functionality, version history browsing.
